sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - Only 5 can be held in a raid inventory at the same time

sections.heading: Info
sections.text:
The Keycard holder case is a container with the purpose of saving space within the player's inventory. It provides 9 inventory slots in a 3x3 grid and only takes up 1 inventory slot itself. It can only store:
- Keycards
- Roubles
- Dollars
- Euros
